specifications.Design: Stained glass robin perched on a branch

1184942.sourceDescription:
## Features
- A detailed robin perched on a branch brings traditional stained glass style and festive character to your Christmas display.
- Twenty warm white LEDs illuminate the robin panel with a gentle glow that complements traditional and contemporary Christmas decorations.
- Power the decoration with 2 x AA batteries or the included USB cable, allowing flexible placement when a suitable USB power source is available.
- The 6-hour on and 18-hour off timer automatically manages the lighting cycle, repeating at approximately the same time each day.
- Double-sided robin design, measuring H25 x L25 x W5cm, for attractive display on shelves and in Christmas arrangements.
- Warm white LEDs create a soft, welcoming glow for festive indoor displays.
- The double-sided decoration can be enjoyed from either direction, making it suitable for shelves and other indoor displays.
- Choose between 2 x AA battery power or the included USB cable for flexible placement around the home.
- The integrated timer provides 6 hours of illumination followed by 18 hours off, repeating daily at approximately the same time.
- For indoor use only, helping you create a seasonal display inside the home.

## Information
Add seasonal character to your home with this Samuel Alexander stained glass robin Christmas decoration. The detailed robin, perched on a branch, is presented in a decorative panel with a traditional stained glass appearance and 20 warm white LEDs for a soft festive glow. Its double-sided design allows the robin scene to be viewed from either direction. The decoration can be powered by 2 x AA batteries or the included USB cable, giving you flexibility when choosing where to display it. An integrated 6-hour on and 18-hour off timer provides convenient automatic daily illumination. Measuring 25cm high, 25cm long and 5cm wide, it is suitable for indoor use only.

## Features
- Energy efficient long life led bulbs Warm Cool
- Connectable system up to 100m in 5m or 10m sets
- Flexible weatherproof cable, strong and easy install

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.
